title: Old blueprints
style: cinematic horror film still, dramatic moody lighting, empty mid-century office tower at night, flickering fluorescent green-white light, long polished corridors and brass elevator doors, film grain, 35mm, highly detailed, subject clearly visible, no text, no watermark
caption:
Part 3. The thirteenth floor was removed in 1958. After the incident. 📐

Original fiction. Part 4 tomorrow night.

#scarystories #horrorstory #creepy #storytime #fyp

scenes.narration: Last time: camera thirteen showed an office full of workers, in the middle of the night. Then they all turned to look at the camera.
scenes.image: grainy surveillance image of 1950s office workers staring into the lens

scenes.narration: Tess killed the feed. She sat in the bright lobby until sunrise and didn't look at the elevator once.
scenes.image: a woman guard sitting rigid at a lobby desk at dawn, her back to the brass elevator doors

scenes.narration: The next night she went down to the basement archive. The building keeps everything. Leases. Receipts. The original plans from 1949.
scenes.image: a dim basement archive with tall metal shelves of rolled blueprints, a single bare bulb overhead

scenes.narration: She unrolled them on the concrete. Thirteen floors. Clear as anything. A full floor of offices, right where the roof is now.
scenes.image: old blue architectural blueprints unrolled on a concrete floor in a flashlight beam, the drawings faded

scenes.narration: Then a second set, dated 1958. Twelve floors. The thirteenth simply gone. As if it had never been built.
scenes.image: two old blueprints side by side on a basement floor, a woman's hand pressing their corners flat

scenes.narration: Stapled to the back was a typed memo. Floor thirteen removed. After the incident. Staff not to be discussed.
scenes.image: a single yellowed typed page stapled to the back of an old blueprint, the type too faded to make out

scenes.narration: No details. No names. Just one more line at the bottom, in pencil, in a hurried hand. They are still on the clock.
scenes.image: close-up of faint pencil marks at the bottom of an old yellowed page, flashlight glare

scenes.narration: Then she heard the elevator. It doesn't go to the basement. It never has.
scenes.image: a woman crouched among blueprints in a dark archive, looking up sharply toward the ceiling

scenes.narration: The stairwell door creaked open behind her. Footsteps on the stairs. Unhurried. Hard leather soles.
scenes.image: a basement stairwell door slowly opening into darkness, a thin wedge of fluorescent light

scenes.narration: A man's voice, polite, from the dark: Miss Varga? They're asking for you upstairs.
scenes.image: a tall shadow in a 1950s suit and hat standing at the top of a dark basement stairwell
